description: FNPF AMR with a resolved floating body on a 2D grid: the box of fnpf_2d_6dof_box (surge/heave/pitch free) on a refined mesh, one level, the zone follows the body (G 12). The psi solves of the loads (psi_0 every stage, surge/heave/pitch unit modes every step) are composite solves with the exact x-z factorisation of the preconditioner; the rows and the factorisation of the phi solve of a stage are kept for them (lap_same).
covers: fnpf_amr lap_same: rows and preconditioner of a stage kept for the psi solves
fnpf_amr 2D x-z factorisation with fixed rows (body)
